id: title:Gilbert09:compare delta timestamp bounds in one offset shape

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion workflow: parsing stored min/max bounds from warehouse metadata and commit logs. Mismatched timezone awareness between warehouse metadata and stored bounds could cause fold failures or incorrect aggregation. This change normalizes timestamps before comparison, preserving timezone information while allowing safe folding of bounds regardless of warehouse metadata.
review.reason: The change replaces datetime imports with UTC and adds a `_normalize_timestamp` helper to handle timezone-naive vs aware mismatches, wired into warehouse metadata parsing. This prevents fold failures and incorrect aggregation in warehouse ingestion, a substantive bounded correctness improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the provided observation's interpretation of warehouse metadata compatibility; no independent test results or runtime behavior are supplied. The benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than demonstrated by execution or test assertions.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader systemic benefit and implementation completeness.

observations.behavior: Replaced datetime imports to include UTC; added _normalize_timestamp helper to handle timezone-naive vs aware datetime mismatches; wired helper into timestamp parsing; added tests for mixed timezone offset scenarios.
observations.code_quote: return value.astimezone(UTC) if value.tzinfo is not None else value.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
